name: favourite-plain-link-restarts-in-a-peek
description: An off-site link clicked in a favourite's tab is cancelled by the peek throttle and reopened in a fresh WebContents, so the page starts a renderer before it asks for the page. The run log now carries one line per step: the cancel, the load start, the card, the first paint. The stamps on those lines are the measurement the task asks for. Same fixture and prelude as favourite-off-site-link-opens-a-peek, and the click lands on the PLAIN link below the target=_blank one.

actions.note: first paint, and the sidebar announces itself
sidebar rebuilds so far. Read again once the favourite's tab has landed: the difference is the rebuild count for one tab open
the only favourite tile, at a sibling scenario's coordinates. This click OPENS and CLAIMS the tab.
VACUITY GUARD: no claim, nothing below is about a favourite's tab
the meta refresh moved the tab off the stored URL

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('plain').getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify([Math.round(b.x + b.width / 2), Math.round(b.y + b.height / 2)]); })()
actions.note: page-space centre of the plain link, to correct the click below when it misses (screen = page + 280,+35 on this VM)
THE MEASUREMENT: the plain off-site link. plain-rect read page-space [394,445] on the 2026-09-10 run, so screen y is 480

assertions.desc: the browser window AND the card
VACUITY GUARD: the claimed tab left the stored URL before the click
